snippet.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire | Extended “Experimental Weapons" Showcase - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
FGS Live From gamescom latam reveals an exclusive look at the ‘Experimental Weapons’ in the highly anticipated MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. The COOL-D Freeze Gun lets you turn foes into giant ice pops, the CLEAN-D Turpentine Gun fires toxic goop which literally melts your enemies, and the MIND-D Conscious Gun fires hypnotic waves to control the competition. In this developer interview, Fumi Games talks about their new game where you play as private investigator ‘Jack Pepper’, battling through a noir-inspired city teeming with gangs, mobs and crooks. MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is coming to Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch later in 2025.
